basic_profile.bio: CuriousExplorer123 is a 27-year-old digital artist living in Portland, Oregon. With a passion for both the macabre and the imaginative, they enjoy exploring niche online communities. They work as a freelance illustrator, often drawing inspiration from fantasy and sci-fi genres. In their free time, they enjoy listening to drum and bass music and exploring blockchain technology, particularly Cardano. Typically, they are active online during late evenings, often after 9 PM PST. Currently single, they appreciate the freedom to dive deep into their various interests without distraction.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CuriousExplorer123 has a background in digital art, which they pursued through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. They hold a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have spent countless hours honing their craft through online tutorials and art communities. Additionally, they have a budding interest in cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, which they explore through online forums and self-study.
